contract: Shared fixture corpus for the canonical draft-path predicates. @dsh-cc/permission-rules owns the predicates (src/vwa-paths.ts) and @dsh-cc/vwa-evidence restates them (src/vwa-paths.ts) WITHOUT importing permission-rules; both packages load THIS file in their own tests and assert identical verdicts. The fixture is the contract: change it in the same commit as either matcher, never one side alone.

vocabulary.rel: workspace-relative POSIX path (never absolute, never backslash-separated)
vocabulary.draftPrefix: expected isVwaDraftPrefix(rel) — the DRAFT_PREFIX_RE shape granted writePaths use: .dsh/vwa/<projectId>/drafts(/**)?
vocabulary.projectId: expected vwaProjectIdOfDraft(rel), null when the path is not a draft file
